title: OK since we’re all posting our games.
author: LegendaryLeg-End
selftext:
So this might be a slightly different story.  During Covid I was determined to try and write my own game. I wanted to make something to play in my arcade cabinet that honoured old-school vertical shooters from the 80s and 90s. 

Having very game dev experience and feeling Unity and others were too much for my little project i decided on Godot 3.x.  I had a lot of fun and ended up releasing on itch. 

The Godot released 4.x and it would have needed a lot of work to convert it so I left it as is for 5 years!  After playing with Claude I asked it to convert to 4.x and within 5 mins I had the full game working! 

I then used Claude to optimise the code, add new features, effects and even music. 

This is the result. Not going to be for everyone but I’m proud of my little game.  

Game is free (donations welcome but definitely not expected for this little project)

https://sparkysoft.itch.io/xx-blast
